function a<K extends string>(k: K, r: Record<string, number>) { r[k] = "x"; }
function b<K extends string>(k: K, r: { a: number }) { r[k] = 1; }
function c<K extends number>(k: K, r: Record<string, boolean>) { r[k] = true; r[k] = 1; }
function d<K extends string>(k: K, r: number[]) { r[k] = 1; }
function e<K extends "a" | "b">(k: K, r: { a: number; b: string }) { r[k] = 1; }
function f<K extends "a" | "b">(k: K, r: { a: number; b: number }) { r[k] = 1; }
function g<K extends string, V>(k: K, v: V, r: Record<string, V>) { r[k] = v; r[k] = 1; }
function h<T, K extends keyof T>(t: T, k: K) { t[k] = 1; }
function i<K extends `x${string}`>(k: K, r: Record<string, number>) { r[k] = 2; }
function j<K extends symbol>(k: K, r: Record<string, number>) { r[k] = 2; }
function m<K extends string>(k: K, r: Map<string, number>) { r[k] = 2; }
function n<K extends string>(k: K, r: Record<string, number>) { const x: number = r[k]; return x; }
